source_policy: No target velocity, fitted rotation, dark halo, or dynamical mass is read by the source builder.
P5 nonzero ICA labels are missing. HI released moment-map zeros are blanked or nondetected, never measured empty space. CO signed values and error maps are retained.
Cell means use signed flux before nonnegative physical-density projection. Clipped-negative flux is reported. This is a sensitivity construction, not an unbiased likelihood inversion.
Uncovered-zero and annular-fill cases are conditional alternatives, neither a measured total density nor confidence bounds. Within-cell missing-at-random extrapolation is explicit in annular case.
Native instrumental blurring remains in source maps. No deconvolution, warp, bulge decomposition, or observed vertical-height claim is made.
Exponential vertical profiles are discretely mass-normalized; heights are illustrative, not independently measured posterior draws.
The 18-20 kpc taper excludes unmeasured outer mass conditionally. Hot/ionized gas, CO-dark gas and a central compact component remain unaccounted for.
Gravity is solved from the combined three-dimensional baryons; component-by-component MOND boosts are forbidden.
Newtonian boundary uses source monopole, dipole and quadrupole. MOND boundary uses the spherical simple-nu monopole; omitted nonspherical exterior terms require box convergence.
Radial force-equivalent speed is a diagnostic, not a self-consistent circular orbit in a barred potential or an admitted motion likelihood.
